notes_for_editor: Thin. Only two lists name this lookout: the Eastern US Lookouts NC page (heading only, no dates, no description) and the tnlandforms NC tower list (coordinates and code EB2543, no status). Neither gives a build date, design, height, staffing, fires, or fate. Two web searches, the Cumberland County fire-station notes (Legeros PDF, which covers fire stations not towers), and the Hope Mills town history pages did not mention a tower. The NHLR and FFLOS caches have no NC Hope Mills entry. The story runs about 70 words, well under the usual 120 for a thin record; it was kept short rather than padded. Next checks: NC Division of Forest Resources tower records, Cumberland County Public Library local history, and Peter Barr's guide to NC lookout towers. The 'NGS' register in the brief was not checked against EB2543.
